statement: (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let E := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun n => ¬ (n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))).sum v / (X : ℝ); let e := fun (X : ℕ) => Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3 / Real.sqrt X; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → E X ≤ C * e X) → (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let M := fun (X : ℕ) => (w X).sum v / (X : ℝ); let e := fun (X : ℕ) => Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3 / Real.sqrt X; ∀ (K : ℝ) (B : ℕ), ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ K * e X < M X) → (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, B < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ (p+2).Prime)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 差二窄窗 · TP-0006 · 合成无条件窄窗归约
plain_statement.en: New route · Gap-two windows · TP-0006 · Combine the unconditional window reduction

brief.zh: 用污染估计中的同一常数 K，在 B 之外选尺度，再抽取 p。
brief.en: Use the contamination constant as K beyond B and extract p from the strict surplus.
